main_Nd_to_Li.label: Track 1 (primary, chemically sensible)
main_Nd_to_Li.scheme: Nd3+ replaces Li+ at Li site. Charge compensation: -3 Li per Nd (1 for site replacement + 2 for charge balance). O substitutes S in PS4 (16e), Hard-Hard preference (Nd-O proximity).
main_Nd_to_Li.rationale: Size + charge match (Nd 0.88-0.98 Å vs Li 0.59-0.76 Å, ratio 1.3x). Vacancy compensation natural (Li5.4 family already has 0.6 vacancy/fu). PS4 framework preserved.

control_Nd_to_P.label: Track 2 (control, demonstrate instability)
control_Nd_to_P.scheme: Nd3+ replaces P5+ at PS4 center. Charge compensation: +2 Li per Nd as interstitials. O substitutes S in PS4. PI-suggested scheme.
control_Nd_to_P.rationale_to_test: Although chemically unfavorable (P 0.17 Å vs Nd 0.88 Å, 5.2x size mismatch), test computationally to quantify the cost. Argues 'we considered this scheme but data shows X eV less stable.'
control_Nd_to_P.compute_priority: SIDE/CONTROL — demonstrate instability via formation energy gap
control_Nd_to_P.expected_outcome: ΔE_form(Nd→P) > ΔE_form(Nd→Li) by ~1-3 eV per Nd. Strong argument for Track 1 in paper.

zhao2025_Ce_O_co_substitution.their_claim: Ce⁴⁺ substitutes P⁵⁺ at 4b; O at 16e (PS4 internal)
zhao2025_Ce_O_co_substitution.challenge_from_PI: Park (BML) cited this as evidence that lanthanide P-substitution works, challenging our Nd→P infeasibility conclusion
zhao2025_Ce_O_co_substitution.our_refutation: Zhao formula assumes CeO₂ + Ce⁴⁺ + P-site (3 assumptions). Honest derivation with sulfide-stable Ce³⁺ + Ce₂O₃ precursor + Li-site yields Li_{5.4-3x}Ce_xPS_{4.4-1.5x}O_{1.5x}Cl_{1.6} = identical structure to our Nd Track 1. SI evidence (O 1s XPS no PS3O3- peak, Raman PS4 unchanged, Table S2 O@4d not 16e, Ce occ 3.6× nominal, LiCl impurity 6%→3% confounder) does NOT support P-site mechanism.
zhao2025_Ce_O_co_substitution.implication_for_our_paper: Cite Zhao in Discussion as a contrasting case: 'Although Zhao et al. reported Ce/O substitution in same composition with claimed P-site Ce, our analysis of their SI shows O 1s XPS lacks PS3O3- signature and Rietveld places O on free 4d site, suggesting their compound likely has Ce@Li-site analogous to our Nd Track 1.'

O_placement_ambiguity.issue: Zhao 2025 places O on 4d (free S²⁻) per Rietveld, NOT 16e (PS4 corner) per main text. Our Track 1A currently places O on 16e (Hard-Hard near Nd). DFT must decide.
O_placement_ambiguity.resolution: Track 1B added: enumerate_track1_O4d.py places O on 4d. Compare DFT energies of Track 1A (O@16e) vs Track 1B (O@4d) — winner becomes paper's main result.

concentration_scaling.issue: Reviewer may challenge x=0.20 (DFT) vs x=0.02 (Zhao experimental) — 10× concentration gap.
concentration_scaling.resolution: Dilute control: 248-atom supercell (Model C × 4), 2 Nd at maximally separated Li sites, x=0.10. Compare ΔE_form/Nd at x=0.10 vs x=0.20. If similar (±0.5 eV) → defect-defect interaction minor → conclusion extends to dilute.
concentration_scaling.expected_cost: ~10 days KISTI (DFT+U+ISPIN=2 on 248-atom × 1-2 configs each for Track 1 and Track 2)
